title: FlutterFlow Developer Needed for Mobile App MVP (iOS & Android)
description:
We're looking for an experienced FlutterFlow developer to build an MVP mobile application from an existing product blueprint, user journeys and wireframes.

The project will be built directly within our FlutterFlow account/workspace. We will retain full ownership of all work created, including FlutterFlow assets, workflows, database structures, source code, documentation and any other project artefacts.

The successful developer will:

Build the MVP in FlutterFlow using documented requirements and wireframes
Create a clean, functional prototype UI using standard FlutterFlow and publicly available design assets/components
Apply basic UX and visual design skills to produce a polished prototype suitable for user testing
Minimise custom code and use FlutterFlow best practices wherever possible
Configure integrations such as authentication, database, storage, maps and QR functionality
Build reusable components and maintain a scalable architecture
Document key workflows and hand over all work at project completion

Important requirements:

Must work exclusively in our FlutterFlow instance
Client retains full IP ownership of all deliverables
NDA must be signed before detailed requirements are shared
Experience building privacy-focused consumer mobile applications is highly regarded

Required Skills & Experience
Strong FlutterFlow development experience
Experience delivering complete mobile app MVPs
Flutter/Dart knowledge for any required custom actions
Firebase (Authentication, Firestore, Storage, Cloud Functions)
Google Maps / geolocation integrations
QR code and deep-linking implementations
Mobile app architecture and data modelling
iOS and Android deployment experience
Understanding of background location services and permissions
UX/UI design capability using standard components and design systems
Ability to translate detailed product requirements and wireframes into a working prototype

Preferred Experience
Consumer/mobile marketplace or social applications
Location-aware applications
Privacy-first product design
MVP development and startup products
Experience handing over FlutterFlow projects for ongoing development

Screening Questions
How many FlutterFlow apps have you built and launched?
Can you provide examples of FlutterFlow projects you have personally developed?
Have you implemented authentication, maps and QR/deep-link functionality in FlutterFlow?
How do you approach building scalable FlutterFlow architectures that can grow beyond an MVP?
Have you worked directly within a client's FlutterFlow account before?
Are you comfortable signing an NDA before reviewing the full product specification?
What is your experience with Firebase integrations and background location features?

title: Cold Email Specialist for Accounting Firms | 5+ Booked Calls/Month | Instantly, PlusVibe, SendKit
description:
We help accounting firms generate 5+ new clients a month through cold email; without them touching outreach. We build and manage cold email campaigns that target their ideal customers and give them a consistent pipeline of new business.

We're looking for a cold email specialist with proven experience running campaigns specifically for accounting firms in the UK and/or USA.
What we need:

•	End-to-end campaign ownership: list building, copywriting, deliverability/inbox management, and optimization through to booked meetings — not just inbox setup
•	Fluency with Instantly.io, PlusVibe, or SendKit
•	Strong written and spoken English, and availability for weekly catch-up calls

To apply, please include:

•	2-3 links to relevant past work, OR
•	A short case study: the client's pain points, what you did, and the measurable outcome (time saved, cost saved, or revenue generated)

Work structure:

•	Fixed monthly price, with campaigns typically running 2-3 months depending on the client
•	Bonus incentives for campaigns that significantly outperform targets

Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed and selected based on fit.

title: Medical Research & Literature Specialist, Systematic Reviews & Evidence Synthesis
description:
We are looking for a qualified Medical Researcher / Medical Doctor with strong experience in medical literature research, evidence synthesis, and scientific writing.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable searching and evaluating medical literature, analyzing research findings, and producing clear, evidence-based summaries and reports.

You will work on projects involving clinical research, literature reviews, medical research reports, and evidence-based content.

Responsibilities
- Conduct comprehensive medical literature searches using PubMed, Google Scholar, Cochrane Library, and other academic databases
- Review and critically evaluate peer-reviewed medical research
- Perform literature reviews and evidence synthesis
- Summarize clinical studies and research findings accurately
- Identify relevant studies, trends, limitations, and gaps in existing research
- Assist with systematic and narrative literature reviews
- Extract and organize data from research papers
- Prepare research summaries, reports, and evidence-based documents
- Ensure references and citations are accurate and properly formatted
- Maintain high standards of medical and scientific accuracy


Required Skills
- Medical degree (MD, MBBS, or equivalent) or strong academic background in medicine/healthcare
- Proven experience in medical research and literature review
- Strong understanding of clinical research methodology
- Excellent knowledge of PubMed and scientific literature databases
- Ability to critically evaluate research papers and clinical studies
- Strong medical/scientific writing skills
- Experience with systematic or narrative literature reviews
- Understanding of evidence-based medicine
- Strong attention to detail
- Excellent English communication skills
- Ability to independently research a topic and deliver well-structured results

Please provide:

1. Your medical/academic background
2. Previous experience with medical research or literature reviews
3. Examples of relevant research work or publications, if available
4. The medical databases and research tools you regularly use
5. Your hourly rate and availability

title: SAP Pharma Manufacturing Expert | Process Intelligence AI PoC |
description:
SAP Process Intelligence / Pharma Manufacturing Expert – Freelance Project

We are looking for a senior SAP / Process Excellence professional with strong pharmaceutical manufacturing experience to support an AI-driven Process Intelligence project.

The project focuses on analyzing Batch Review & Release / Manufacturing Quality processes using SAP and related quality/process data, and translating business requirements into practical functional requirements for the development team. 

Scope:

* Understand pharma manufacturing and quality processes and translate requirements into functional specifications
* Work with SAP process/event data to identify delays, bottlenecks, rework, deviations and quality risks
* Define relevant process KPIs, outcome KPIs, benchmarks and improvement opportunities
* Support process reconstruction and analysis using SAP/QMS/LIMS/MES data
* Guide the development team on functional requirements and validate the solution
* Support the design of Process Excellence dashboards and an AI Copilot experience
* Ensure insights are evidence-based and suitable for pharmaceutical/GxP environments

Must Have:

* Strong SAP and pharmaceutical manufacturing experience
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA and manufacturing/quality processes
* Knowledge of SAP PP, QM, PM and preferably SAP DM/MII/MES
* Strong process excellence or process mining experience
* Ability to understand business requirements and work directly with developers
* Previous experience working with pharmaceutical manufacturing or quality teams

Good to Have:

* Experience with SAP Signavio, Celonis or Adonis
* Knowledge of GMP, ICH Q9/Q10 or APQC Life Sciences
* Experience with QMS, LIMS or MES data
* AI/GenAI or Copilot-based process intelligence experience

Budget: $500-$700 (Open to discuss Commercials)
Engagement: Freelance / Project-based

Please apply only if you have directly relevant SAP + pharmaceutical manufacturing/process intelligence experience.

In your proposal, briefly share:

1. Your SAP modules and years of experience
2. Relevant pharma manufacturing projects
3. Experience with Celonis, Signavio or Adonis
4. Your availability for the project

title: Reputation Manager for DTC Brand | Negative Trustpilot Review Removal
description:
We are a fast-growing DTC health device brand selling across the US, UK, Canada, Australia and Ireland. High order volume, physical product plus subscription. We need someone who owns negative Trustpilot review removal end to end, with a heavy focus on directly contacting unhappy reviewers, fixing their problem, and getting the review taken down or updated.

Core focus 1: reviewer outreach and resolution
This is where most of your time goes. Every negative review is a customer we can still win back.

- Match each negative reviewer to their order in our systems and pull the full support and shipping history
- Reach out personally by email or phone through our support desk, understand what actually went wrong, and own the case until it is resolved
- Use the resolution tools we give you: replacements, reshipments, partial refunds, returns, product coaching, subscription fixes. You get a clear mandate so you can move fast without waiting on approvals
- Once the customer is genuinely satisfied, invite them to update or remove their review
- Follow up on cases that stall, keep a clean pipeline, and never let a resolvable review sit untouched
- Report resolution rate and how many reviews were updated or removed as a result

Core focus 2: negative Trustpilot review removal via flagging
For reviews that cannot be resolved with the customer directly.

- Audit every negative review live on our profile and classify which are removable
- Identify guideline breaches: non-genuine experiences, reviewers who never ordered from us, competitor and spam reviews, harassment, promotional content, reviews on the wrong company profile, and claims we can disprove with order, shipping and support data
- Build evidence packs and file removal requests through Trustpilot's official reporting process
- Own the full appeal cycle including follow-ups and escalation when a request is rejected
- Track removal success rate and which grounds actually work for us

Supporting responsibilities
- Write public replies to negative reviews in our brand voice, calm and non-defensive, never templated
- Flag systemic issues back to us when the same complaint keeps repeating, so we fix the root cause
- Build and optimize automated review invitation flows via Klaviyo and the Trustpilot integration to lift genuine review velocity
- Weekly report: rating, review count, reviewers contacted, cases resolved, reviews updated or removed, removal requests filed and won

Who we are looking for
- Proven negative review removal and reviewer outreach experience for ecommerce, DTC or dropshipping brands, ideally health, wellness or consumer devices
- Strong customer service instincts. You are comfortable talking to angry customers and turning them around
- Hands-on Trustpilot Business account experience: flagging, appeals, invitation flows, response management
- Deep knowledge of Trustpilot's guidelines and which grounds actually get reviews removed
- Excellent written English, native or near-native
- Self-directed and organized, works a clean case pipeline and reports weekly without being chased
- Bonus: Klaviyo, Gorgias, Shopify

description:
Social Media Graphic Designer for Digital Solutions Brand

We’re looking for a graphic designer to create ongoing social media content for IDRAK, a digital solutions company.

We will provide the content, copy, brand direction, and references. We need someone who can turn that into clean, polished, professional Instagram designs that feel consistent without making every post look the same.

What we need

* Instagram posts and carousels
* Mainly 1080 × 1350 designs
* Arabic and English / bilingual layouts
* Clean, modern, technology-focused visual style
* Strong Arabic typography and RTL layout
* UI mockups and digital product visuals when needed
* Consistency with our existing branding
* Editable source files in Canva or Figma

Our visual direction is:

* clean and minimal
* lots of white space
* modern and professional
* strong typography
* purple accents
* simple line icons
* polished UI/product mockups
* editorial rather than overly promotional

We do **not** want:

* generic Canva templates
* overly busy designs
* heavy 3D/AI visuals
* excessive gradients or neon effects
* repetitive layouts across every post


Posts may advertise:

* websites
* mobile applications
* fitness and gym applications
* real estate applications
* service platforms
* business systems
* B2B platforms
* other custom digital solutions


We’d prefer someone who has experience with:

* technology / SaaS / digital brands
* Arabic social media design
* bilingual Arabic-English layouts
* app or web UI presentation
* ongoing social media design systems


Please send:

1. Your portfolio
2. Relevant Arabic or bilingual work
3. Examples of tech/SaaS/social media designs
4. Your price per post or monthly package
5. Whether you work in Canva, Figma, or both
6. Your usual turnaround time

We may begin with one **paid test post** before moving into ongoing work.

title: CAD Designer Needed for Waterproof IoT Electronics Enclosure
description:
We are looking for an experienced mechanical/CAD designer to design a compact, durable enclosure for AquaSense, an electronic water-quality monitoring device.

The enclosure will house an assembled PCB, sensors, connectors, antennas, and related electronic components. It must be suitable for use near water and in outdoor environments. The design should be practical to assemble, maintain, prototype, and manufacture.

Scope of work:

* Review the PCB, component placement, connector locations, and available mechanical information.
* Develop the complete enclosure around the electronics.
* Create accurate mounting features for the PCB and internal components.
* Provide suitable openings and mounting arrangements for sensors, cables, connectors, antennas, buttons, and indicators.
* Design the enclosure for splash/water resistance using appropriate seals, gaskets, O-rings, or cable glands.
* Include practical fastening and service-access features.
* Optimize the first version for 3D printing and prototype assembly.
* Recommend modifications required for eventual injection moulding or low-volume manufacturing.
* Produce realistic renders of the completed enclosure.

Required deliverables:

* Editable source CAD files
* STEP files
* STL files for 3D printing
* 2D manufacturing drawings with critical dimensions
* Exploded assembly view
* Bill of materials for mechanical parts such as screws, inserts, seals, and cable glands
* Rendered images of the final design
* At least two revision rounds

Preferred experience:

* Electronics enclosure and product casing design
* Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Creo, Inventor, or similar professional CAD software
* Waterproof or weather-resistant enclosure design
* Designing around PCBs, connectors, antennas, and sensors
* 3D-printing and injection-moulding design principles
* Experience with threaded inserts, gaskets, O-rings, snap-fits, bosses, and cable glands
* Good understanding of tolerances and design for assembly

When applying, please include:

1. Examples of electronic enclosures or waterproof products you have designed.
2. The CAD software you use.
3. Your proposed design process.
4. Your estimated completion time.
5. Your fixed-price quotation or hourly rate.
6. Any information you would require from us before beginning.

We will provide the PCB STEP model, PCB dimensions, connector and sensor information, product requirements, reference images, and other available mechanical files.

Please start your proposal with the words “AquaSense Enclosure” so we know you have read the complete description. All design files and project information must remain confidential and become the property of the client after payment.

title: Greek-Speaking Lead Qualification & Appointment Setter
description:
We are looking for a Greek-speaking Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting Specialist to work with us on an ongoing basis.

What You’ll Do

We already have the leads — you do not need to generate or find leads.

Every day, we will provide you with a new set of leads to contact.

Your responsibilities will be to:

Call the leads provided by us.
Communicate with them professionally in Greek.
Understand their requirements and qualify the lead based on our criteria.
Explain our service/company briefly and handle basic questions.
For qualified and interested leads, schedule a meeting with our team.
Update the status and outcome of every lead contacted.
Follow up with leads when required.
Requirements
Fluent/native-level Greek is mandatory.
Good communication and telephone skills.
Previous experience in cold calling, telesales, lead qualification, or appointment setting is preferred.
Comfortable making outbound calls every day.
Organized and able to maintain accurate lead/contact records.
Reliable and available for ongoing work.
What We Provide
Fresh leads provided daily.
Clear qualification criteria and calling guidelines.
Information/training about our service.
Meeting/calendar booking process.

This is an ongoing opportunity for the right person. Our main objective is simple: contact the leads, qualify genuine opportunities, and schedule meetings with our team.

When applying, please mention your Greek language proficiency, previous calling/appointment-setting experience, and your availability.

title: Create a Course: "Sell Your Digital Products & Build Your Personal Brand"
description:
We're looking for someone who has actually sold their own digital products, courses, or services to create a practical micro-course for MUAB, a knowledge platform for professional digital products, in partnership with KBB (Knowledge Business Bloom).

Language: Arabic is strongly preferred, as our primary audience is Arabic-speaking, Arabic speakers will be prioritized. However, we will also consider outstanding English-speaking candidates with proven results; in that case the course may be delivered in English and localized by our team. Tell us in your application which language(s) you can deliver in.

Who this course is for

Experts, trainers, consultants, and specialists who have real experience and knowledge — but no idea how to turn it into income. This course takes them from "I know things" to "I sell digital products under my own brand."

Course direction (high level)

The general theme: turning your experience into sellable digital products, building a personal brand as an expert, marketing content that attracts buyers, and making your first sales without a big audience.

Note: this is the direction, not the final scope. After selection, we will work with you in depth to define the exact content, our team has a detailed content and production guide, and the final outline will be built together in a kickoff session before any recording begins. You bring the field experience; we bring the platform's learning framework. Applicants should propose an initial outline to show their thinking, knowing it will be refined jointly.

Format & quality standards (full production guide provided on contract)

- 8–12 video lessons, each 3–5 minutes, one core idea per lesson
- High production quality is mandatory: 1080p minimum, external microphone, clean audio with no echo or background noise, front lighting, eye-level camera — a sample lesson must pass our quality review -before you produce the rest
- Extra materials are required, not optional: downloadable templates, a practical guide, and worksheets/checklists — at least one tool per 2–3 lessons, delivered as usable files (fillable PDF, Word, Excel, or Canva), matching the video content exactly

What we require from YOU

- Proof you've sold your own digital products, courses, coaching, or consulting, show us real results
- 5+ years of experience in marketing, the creator economy, or personal branding
- Clear, confident on-camera presence
- 100% original content

Selection & delivery process

Selection based on your experience, video sample, and initial outline
Kickoff session: we define the final course content together, guided by our team's content guide
One sample lesson (video + its downloadable tool) — approved before producing the rest
Full delivery: all videos + all templates/guides + written scripts, organized and numbered
Two revision rounds included

Intellectual property — full transfer

Upon approval and full payment, all intellectual property, publishing, distribution, and resale rights transfer completely and permanently to the company. This is a full buyout — one fixed payment, no royalties or ongoing claims. The course will be published under your name on our platform as recognition of your expertise.

title: Logo & Packaging Designer for New Herbal Tea Brand
description:
I’m looking for a designer to help create the logo and packaging for a new herbal tea brand launching in Australia.

A lot of the initial brand work has already been completed, including the general brand direction, colours, fonts, website design and product structure. I’m mainly looking for someone who can take this existing direction and develop a clean, professional logo and packaging system.

The initial range includes four tea products plus a complete set, so the packaging should feel consistent across the range while making each product easy to distinguish.

Scope
Logo design
Packaging design for four tea products
Packaging design/direction for the complete set
Final editable and print-ready files

Experience with food, beverage, tea, wellness or consumer-product packaging would be preferred.

When applying, please share a few relevant examples of logo and packaging work you have personally designed.

title: Lottie Animations for a Hardware LCD Menu — Mostly Icons
description:
We are looking for a motion designer / Lottie animator to create simple, clean animations for a hardware LCD screen menu.

We already have the static UI designs prepared in Figma. The example screens below show the general visual style and complexity of the interface.

The main goal is to make these screens feel more alive when they open, without making the interface overly animated or distracting.

What We Need

The designer will receive the static screen designs in Figma and will:

Review the UI and suggest suitable animation ideas for each screen.
Design simple opening/entrance animations for the interface. (Page opening animation will be same for all pages)
Animate selected icons and UI elements.
Break the animations into separate Lottie components/assets where appropriate, rather than delivering only one large animation for the entire screen.
Deliver production-ready Lottie files that can be integrated into a hardware LCD interface.

For example, individual elements such as an icon, waveform, indicator, dial, or small UI graphic may each have their own animation so that our developers can control them independently.

Animation Style

We are not looking for complex, cinematic, or highly elaborate animations.

The style should be:

Simple
Clean
Fast and responsive
Suitable for a small hardware LCD
Minimal and functional
Visually consistent with the existing UI

A good reference for the type of animation we have in mind is this simple Sound Waves animation:

https://lottiefiles.com/free-animation/sound-waves-lzPIXLObNg

We are looking for this kind of simple motion language rather than complex character animation or heavy visual effects.

We prefer simple vector-based animations with limited layers and keyframes. 

The final animations should therefore be designed with the limitations of a hardware LCD and embedded processor in mind.

Workflow
We provide the static Figma screens.
You review the screens and propose animation concepts.
We agree on the animation direction.
You create the animations.
Animations are divided into reusable components where appropriate.
Final Lottie files are delivered for implementation.

Consistent layer structure and naming will also be important because the animations may need to be maintained or modified later.

Deliverables
Lottie animation files (.json and/or .lottie, depending on the implementation requirements)
Separate Lottie components for independently animated UI elements
Source files (After Effects / Figma, depending on the workflow used)
Short preview/video or GIF of the animations for review
Who We're Looking For

We are looking for someone with:

Strong experience with Lottie animations
Experience creating UI / icon / micro-interactions
Good understanding of animation timing and easing
Experience working from Figma designs
An eye for subtle, functional motion
Experience optimizing animations for performance

Please include examples of your Lottie/UI animation work in your proposal, especially simple icon or interface animations.

We are more interested in clean and clever motion design than flashy animation.

title: Operations & Productive.io Assistant – Small Outsourcing Company
description:
Operations & Productive.io Assistant – Small Outsourcing Company

I run a small customer support outsourcing company with a remote team of approximately **7–15 agents depending on the season**.

I am looking for a highly organized and proactive person who can gradually take responsibility for the operational organization and follow-up within the company.

I am very good at running and growing the business, but organization, monitoring and consistent follow-up are not my strongest areas. I need someone who genuinely enjoys structure and can make sure things don't fall between the cracks.

We recently moved to **Productive.io**, and I need help both setting it up properly and keeping it clean, simple and useful.

### Initially, I need help with:

* Organizing and maintaining our Productive.io workspace
* Making sure agents log their hours correctly
* Monitoring projects, tasks and deadlines
* Following up when something is missing or hasn't been completed
* Keeping client and agent information organized
* Monitoring hours, costs and basic profitability
* Creating simple dashboards/reports that actually help me understand the business
* Flagging anything that requires my attention
* Making sure I follow up on important items instead of them getting forgotten
* Helping improve our internal structure as we grow

I **do not need someone to manage my customer support agents' actual customer conversations**. I need someone on the operational side who keeps track of the bigger picture and makes sure I know what needs my attention.

### The right person

You are extremely organized, independent and comfortable taking initiative.

I don't want to constantly tell you what to check. Over time, I want you to understand how the company operates, notice when something doesn't look right, follow it up and bring important matters to me.

Experience with **Productive.io is a big advantage**. Experience with similar project management/operations platforms is also relevant, but please tell me specifically if you have worked with Productive.io before.

### Growing position

This will start as a **small part-time position with only a few hours per week**.

However, I am specifically looking for someone who could grow with the company. If we work well together, the role can gradually develop into broader **Operations / Business Management support** with more responsibility and more hours.

I am looking for someone reliable who enjoys bringing structure to a growing small business and who can become the organized person behind the scenes that keeps everything moving.

When applying, please briefly tell me:

1. Have you worked with Productive.io before?
2. Have you monitored remote teams or multiple projects/clients?
3. How would you help an owner who struggles with organization and follow-up?
4. What is your hourly rate?
5. How many hours per week are you currently available?

title: Fashionable Shoe Testers Needed (Bunion / Hallux Valgus Focus)
description:
We are looking for people with bunions (hallux valgus) who want comfortable and fashionable shoes with low heels.

Our team tests selected shoe models currently available on the market before we brand and list them in our ecommerce store. We provide the shoes, and you provide real-life feedback and simple walking videos.

What we provide
- 5 pairs of low-heel shoes for testing
- Clear testing instructions
- A personal report based on your walking analysis and feedback

What you will do
- Fill out short forms (before and after testing)
- Record walking videos using your mobile phone (top view, from above)
- Wear the shoes as instructed and share comfort, fit, and style feedback

How your data is used
- We use advanced video analysis algorithms to evaluate walking patterns and understand how each shoe model influences gait.
- Combined with your form responses, this helps us confirm whether a model is truly suitable for hallux valgus users.

Ideal candidate
- Adult with bunions / hallux valgus
- Interested in fashionable low-heel footwear
- Owns a smartphone with a decent camera
- Reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable following instructions

To apply, please include
- Your shoe size
- Your country/shipping location
- A short note about your bunion condition and current footwear challenges

title: Full-Time Social Media & Content Assistant
description:
Full-Time Social Media & Content Assistant

I'm looking for someone to work with me full-time (40 hours per week) managing my social media engagement.

Initially, the role will be focused almost entirely on LinkedIn.

I'm looking for someone for the long term. I don't want someone who just wants another VA job for a few months. I want someone who can learn how I communicate, understand my content and businesses, and gradually take on much more responsibility.

For the right person, this role has a lot of room to grow.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING INITIALLY

Your main responsibilities will be:

* Replying to comments on my LinkedIn posts
* Managing and replying to my LinkedIn DMs
* Commenting on a set number of selected LinkedIn profiles every day
* Engaging with people in my network
* Learning how I write, speak and communicate online
* Keeping track of conversations and making sure important messages don't get missed

I'll provide training and examples of how I want everything done.

The goal is for you to eventually understand my voice well enough that I don't need to review everything you do.

INSTAGRAM

I'm also starting to take Instagram seriously.

As that grows, you'll begin helping with:

* Replying to Instagram comments
* Managing Instagram DMs
* Engaging with other accounts
* Helping manage the community around my content

HOW THE ROLE WILL GROW

I don't want this person to stay a social media engagement assistant forever.

As you get better and understand my voice, I want you to start helping more with the actual content.

That could include:

* Creating first drafts of LinkedIn posts
* Turning my rough ideas and voice notes into posts
* Helping research content ideas
* Repurposing content between LinkedIn and Instagram
* Helping with newsletters
* Organising my content pipeline
* Eventually taking ownership of much more of my content operation

The more capable you become, the more responsibility you'll get.

WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

You don't need to be an amazing copywriter on day one.

What's much more important to me is that you are:

* Excellent at written English
* A natural communicator
* Reliable and organised
* Very detail-oriented
* Comfortable using AI tools
* Quick to learn
* Proactive rather than waiting to be told everything
* Interested in social media and content
* Willing to learn my writing style
* Looking for a serious, long-term position
* Willing to go above and beyond when needed

I want someone who takes pride in what they do and genuinely wants to get better.

I'm looking for someone who can eventually become a key part of my team, rather than someone who simply completes a list of tasks every day.

ROLE DETAILS

* 40 hours per week
* Full-time
* Remote
* Long-term
* Working directly with me
* Training provided
* Significant opportunity for the role and responsibilities to grow

HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. A short introduction about yourself
2. Your previous experience with social media, LinkedIn or content
3. Any copywriting or social media examples you have
4. Your expected monthly salary in USD
5. Your normal working hours and timezone
6. Which AI tools you currently use
7. Why you're looking for a long-term role

Please also answer:

If you had been replying to my LinkedIn comments for six months and noticed that I always replied to certain types of comments in a particular way, what would you do with that information?

Start your application with PINEAPPLE so I know you've actually read the full post.

Generic applications will be ignored.

title: Romanian-Speaking Lead Qualification & Appointment Setter
description:
We are looking for a Romanian-speaking Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting Specialist to work with us on an ongoing basis.

What You’ll Do

We already have the leads — you do not need to generate or find leads.

Every day, we will provide you with a new set of leads to contact.

Your responsibilities will be to:

Call the leads provided by us.
Communicate with them professionally in Romanian.
Understand their requirements and qualify the lead based on our criteria.
Explain our service/company briefly and handle basic questions.
For qualified and interested leads, schedule a meeting with our team.
Update the status and outcome of every lead contacted.
Follow up with leads when required.
Requirements
Fluent/native-level Romanian is mandatory.
Good communication and telephone skills.
Previous experience in cold calling, telesales, lead qualification, or appointment setting is preferred.
Comfortable making outbound calls every day.
Organized and able to maintain accurate lead/contact records.
Reliable and available for ongoing work.
What We Provide
Fresh leads provided daily.
Clear qualification criteria and calling guidelines.
Information/training about our service.
Meeting/calendar booking process.

This is an ongoing opportunity for the right person. Our main objective is simple: contact the leads, qualify genuine opportunities, and schedule meetings with our team.

When applying, please mention your Romanian language proficiency, previous calling/appointment-setting experience, and your availability.

title: Recurring YouTube Thumbnail Designer | SaaS + Personal Brand
description:
I'm looking for a talented thumbnail designer to become a regular part of my video production team. This is ongoing work across SaaS and technology brands, finance/fintech content, founder-led YouTube channels, and my own creator/personal brand.
I'm specifically looking for modern, premium YouTube design rather than generic thumbnails with excessive glow, outlines, arrows, or effects. You should have a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, facial crops, modern typography, composition, and creating high-CTR thumbnails without making them look cheap or overly clickbaity. You should also be comfortable working within established brand guidelines.
The initial project is 5 thumbnails for a major fintech/SaaS brand. The budget is $10 USD per completed thumbnail ($50 for the initial set), with recurring work available for the right designer.
To apply, please send your 3 best YouTube thumbnails, ideally including SaaS, business, finance, or creator examples. Please also confirm you're comfortable with $10 per thumbnail for recurring work, your typical turnaround time, and how many thumbnails you can comfortably produce per week.
Please don't send a huge generic portfolio. I'd rather see your 3 strongest and most relevant examples.
I'll likely select a small number of candidates for a paid thumbnail test before choosing the designer for the ongoing work.
Budget: $10/thumbnail | Initial batch: 5 | Ongoing work available

title: Microsoft 365 Administrator / IT Support Specialist Needed
description:
We are looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 Administrator / IT Support Specialist to join our team on an ongoing basis.

We support a growing business environment and need someone who can take ownership of day-to-day Microsoft 365 administration as well as provide Tier 2 technical support to our users.

What you'll be doing
Manage Microsoft 365 users, licenses, groups and permissions
Administer Exchange Online, including mailboxes, shared mailboxes, aliases and mail flow
Troubleshoot Outlook and email delivery issues
Manage Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
Assist with MFA, Conditional Access and authentication issues
Support Microsoft Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive
Handle employee onboarding and offboarding
Troubleshoot Windows 10/11 desktop and application issues
Investigate and resolve escalated Tier 2 support tickets
Troubleshoot Active Directory / Entra Connect synchronization issues
Assist with Microsoft Defender and security-related issues
Use PowerShell for Microsoft 365 administration and troubleshooting
Document solutions and maintain internal IT documentation
Communicate directly with users and provide professional remote support

What we're looking for

You should have:

5+ years of IT support experience
Strong Microsoft 365 administration experience
Strong Exchange Online knowledge
Strong Entra ID / Azure AD knowledge
Experience with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive
Excellent Windows troubleshooting skills
Experience handling Tier 2 escalations
Good understanding of DNS, Active Directory and networking
PowerShell experience
Excellent written and spoken English
Strong communication and documentation skills
Ability to work independently and troubleshoot problems without constant supervision
Nice to have
MSP experience
Microsoft Intune
Microsoft Defender
ServiceNow, Syncro, NinjaOne or similar RMM/help-desk platforms
Experience supporting multiple Microsoft 365 tenants
Hours

20–40 hours per week

We're looking for someone interested in a long-term ongoing relationship, not just a short-term project.

There may also be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities as our IT environment grows.

To apply

Please tell us:

How many years you've worked with Microsoft 365.
Your experience with Exchange Online and Entra ID.
Whether you've worked in an MSP environment.
An example of a difficult Microsoft 365 issue you've diagnosed and resolved.
Your availability and timezone.
Your hourly rate.

Please start your proposal with "M365" so we know you've read the entire post.

title: Postcard Design for Real Estate
description:
Graphic Designer Needed — 3 Luxury Beauty Postcards | Adobe Illustrator + Print Ready Artwork

We are an established Australian cosmetics brand currently undertaking a significant brand elevation and are looking for an experienced graphic designer to complete a set of three customer postcards/order inserts.

The overall creative direction, brand identity, copy and initial design concepts have already been developed. We will provide reference mock-ups showing the intended layouts and feel.

We are looking for someone with a strong editorial/luxury design eye who can take these concepts and professionally refine and execute them for print.

THE PROJECT

There are 3 double-sided postcards:

Card 1 — First Order
A welcome/founder story card designed to build trust and reassure a first-time customer.

Card 2 — Returning Customer
A thank-you and belonging card, including an invitation to our VIP program, The Shortlist.

Card 3 — Loyal Customer
A more intimate recognition card for our long-term customers, built around the message “You’re one of us.”

Each card has already had its messaging, copy and general visual direction developed.

We will supply:

* Brand guidelines and colour palette
* Brand fonts
* Logos and brand assets
* Final/near-final copy
* Design mock-ups for all three postcards
* Photography/assets where required
* Founder signature
* Printer specifications/bleed requirements

title: Backend and Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Lead Backend & Infrastructure Engineer (TypeScript, Node.js, Azure, AI Agents)

Type: Hourly, 40 hrs/week, long term, contract-to-hire
Experience level: Expert
Preferred location:** India, Gujarat preferred. Must overlap 10:00 to 19:00 IST.

---

## About the work

We run an AI-native test intelligence platform for Playwright teams. A reporter streams results, traces, screenshots, and videos into a dashboard in real time, an ML engine classifies failures and scores flaky tests across millions of executions, and an MCP server exposes test context to AI agents. SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 certified, GDPR compliant, running on Azure with a 99.9% enterprise SLA.

## Scope

You own the backend and infrastructure surface: a TypeScript microservices monorepo behind a real-time ingestion pipeline processing artifacts from thousands of CI runs a day. Most senior engineer on this surface, setting technical direction and shipping the roadmap: auto-quarantine for flaky tests, smart test orchestration, a public API, and agentic test management.

## Responsibilities

- Scale real-time ingestion from GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, TeamCity, CircleCI, Bitbucket, and CodeBuild under spiky, high-volume load
- Own nine services in a pnpm monorepo (user, ingestion, data-handler, tcm, ai-insight, billing, integration, mcp) plus a Next.js product frontend on Postgres
- Run and evolve Azure infrastructure: Docker, Nginx, CI/CD, observability, capacity, cost
- Maintain enterprise auth: RS256 JWTs with rotating refresh sessions, SAML 2.0 SSO, SCIM, personal access tokens, API keys, org management
- Build the AI surface: failure classification, the flaky-detection ML pipeline, and a 33-tool MCP server
- Uphold SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls in day-to-day engineering
- Ship and maintain our public npm packages

## Stack

TypeScript, Node.js 18+, pnpm monorepo, REST, Next.js, Apollo GraphQL, PostgreSQL, object storage, Azure, Docker, Nginx, Anthropic Claude APIs, Model Context Protocol SDK, n8n, Playwright ecosystem.

## Requirements

- 6+ years backend in production, 2+ years owning infrastructure or platform surfaces
- Deep TypeScript/Node.js at scale, including Postgres performance work: query plans, indexing, partitioning
- Real cloud operations experience. Azure preferred, strong AWS/GCP transfers
- Built or operated event-driven or streaming pipelines with real throughput and backpressure concerns
- Implemented SSO/SCIM or equivalent enterprise auth, and can work inside SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls without slowing down
- Claude fluency, demonstrated with something you actually built: Claude Code as a daily driver (subagents, skills, hooks, MCP servers), Anthropic Messages API with tool use, streaming, prompt caching, and agent loops that are cheap and reliable in production. Prompts, agent configs, and evals treated as versioned, reviewed, tested artifacts

## Nice to have

Test infrastructure domain experience (Playwright, CI at scale, test reporting), applied ML for classification or anomaly detection, published npm packages, open source contributions.

## Process

1. Intro call, 30 min
2. Technical deep dive, 60 to 90 min: walk through a system you own, then a design discussion on an ingestion or agent-infrastructure problem from our domain
3. Practical exercise, take-home or pairing, your choice, including using Claude Code the way you would on the job
4. Founder conversation and offer

This starts as an ongoing hourly contract with the intent to convert to a permanent role.

## Screening questions
1. Are you based in Gujarat, or open to relocating for a long-term engagement?
2. Describe one system you owned end to end: scale, your specific role, what broke, and how you fixed the class of problem rather than the instance.
3. What have you built with Claude Code or the Anthropic API? Link or short walkthrough.
4. Your notice period and expected hourly rate.

## About the work

We run an AI-native test intelligence platform for Playwright teams. A reporter streams results, traces, screenshots, and videos into a dashboard in real time, an ML engine classifies failures and scores flaky tests across millions of executions, and an MCP server exposes test context to AI agents. SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 certified, GDPR compliant, running on Azure with a 99.9% enterprise SLA.

## Scope

You own the backend and infrastructure surface: a TypeScript microservices monorepo behind a real-time ingestion pipeline processing artifacts from thousands of CI runs a day. Most senior engineer on this surface, setting technical direction and shipping the roadmap: auto-quarantine for flaky tests, smart test orchestration, a public API, and agentic test management.

## Responsibilities

- Scale real-time ingestion from GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, TeamCity, CircleCI, Bitbucket, and CodeBuild under spiky, high-volume load
- Own nine services in a pnpm monorepo (user, ingestion, data-handler, tcm, ai-insight, billing, integration, mcp) plus a Next.js product frontend on Postgres
- Run and evolve Azure infrastructure: Docker, Nginx, CI/CD, observability, capacity, cost
- Maintain enterprise auth: RS256 JWTs with rotating refresh sessions, SAML 2.0 SSO, SCIM, personal access tokens, API keys, org management
- Build the AI surface: failure classification, the flaky-detection ML pipeline, and a 33-tool MCP server
- Uphold SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls in day-to-day engineering
- Ship and maintain our public npm packages

## Stack

TypeScript, Node.js 18+, pnpm monorepo, REST, Next.js, Apollo GraphQL, PostgreSQL, object storage, Azure, Docker, Nginx, Anthropic Claude APIs, Model Context Protocol SDK, n8n, Playwright ecosystem.

## Requirements

- 6+ years backend in production, 2+ years owning infrastructure or platform surfaces
- Deep TypeScript/Node.js at scale, including Postgres performance work: query plans, indexing, partitioning
- Real cloud operations experience. Azure preferred, strong AWS/GCP transfers
- Built or operated event-driven or streaming pipelines with real throughput and backpressure concerns
- Implemented SSO/SCIM or equivalent enterprise auth, and can work inside SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls without slowing down
- Claude fluency, demonstrated with something you actually built: Claude Code as a daily driver (subagents, skills, hooks, MCP servers), Anthropic Messages API with tool use, streaming, prompt caching, and agent loops that are cheap and reliable in production. Prompts, agent configs, and evals treated as versioned, reviewed, tested artifacts

## Nice to have

Test infrastructure domain experience (Playwright, CI at scale, test reporting), applied ML for classification or anomaly detection, published npm packages, open source contributions.

1. Intro call, 30 min

3. Practical exercise, take-home or pairing, your choice, including using Claude Code the way you would on the job
4. Founder conversation and offer

title: Steel Structure Warehouse Castellated Rafter Beam Design
description:
Title:

Structural Engineer – Redesign Steel Warehouse Roof Rafters as Castellated Beams (UB305×165×40)

Structure Size

•	5 Units
•	Each unit – 30m (span) by 60m (Length)
•	Eave height – 10m

Job Description:

I need an experienced structural engineer to redesign the roof rafter beams of an already designed steel warehouse structure by converting them into castellated beams.

Existing Design

•	Roof rafter beams are currently specified as Universal Beams UB 305 × 165 × 40.
•	These same sections will be used as the parent beams for castellation (no change of section size/weight).

Scope of Work

Castellation Design & Calculations (must be completed before any final detailing) 
•	Determine optimal castellation parameters for the UB 305 × 165 × 40 section, including: 
	Expanded depth / final beam depth
	Web opening size, shape (hexagonal preferred unless justified otherwise), pitch and spacing
	Castellation ratio / expansion ratio
	Remaining web thickness and local stability checks
•	Design of required stiffeners (web stiffeners, opening-edge stiffeners, and any intermediate or support stiffeners)
•	Connection plates detailing
•	All hunch detailing
•	New roof slope details & degree increase
•	All other relevant parameters (shear capacity at openings, Vierendeel effects, buckling checks, serviceability, deflection, etc.)

Structural Verification

•	Confirm that the castellated beams satisfy the original design loads and any applicable code requirements.
•	Provide clear calculation package showing that the converted beams meet strength, stability and serviceability criteria.

Final Detailing

•	Produce complete roof castellated beam detailing suitable for fabrication (marking plans, beam elevations, opening geometry, stiffener details, connection details if affected, cutting templates, etc.).

Deliverables

•	Calculation report (PDF) with all castellation parameters, stiffener design and verification.

title: Experienced Fashion Customer Support Specialist
description:
We are a growing American fashion brand for women of 40 and over, scaling fast. We are hiring the person who will own our customer experience.

Read this properly before you apply. This is not general VA work and it is not general customer service.

THE REALITY OF THIS ROLE

Our inbox is a difficult one. Delayed parcels, sizing complaints, refund demands, dispute threats, and customers who are already angry by the time they write. Every email has money on it, and the call you make on each one is final.

Two numbers define the job. Chargebacks stay under 1 percent, and refunds stay within target against revenue. Above 1 percent, payment providers stop working with us, and then there is no store, no team and no role. That sits underneath every reply you write.

Protecting margin while keeping the customer delighted is one job, not two, and doing that one customer at a time, in writing, is the skill we are hiring for.

The cases repeat, and you should recognise every one of these:

- Day 14, the tracking has barely moved, and she wants it cancelled
- The quality is not what she hoped for and she wants to send it back
- The size chart said one thing and the garment says another
- She wants to cancel after the order has already shipped
- Her second line mentions her bank

If that reads like your last job, we should talk. If it reads like a list of problems, this is not the role.

How we work: we accept as few returns as possible. Instead of taking the item back, you offer cash back in steps, so she keeps the piece and stays happy. Choosing the right step for the customer in front of you, and knowing when to move up one, is the core of this job. If you already know why that beats a return, you will be at home here.

Every customer is treated like royalty here, the angry ones included. Our customers are women of 40 and over and they notice exactly how they are spoken to, so the tone has to be right every time. We have response time targets, and quality still comes first.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Own the inbox and write as the voice of the brand. Warm, personal, generous.
- Decide every outcome yourself. Cash back offers, order changes, replacements, exchanges, and where it is genuinely unavoidable, a return or a refund. Plus some light coordination with our supplier.
- Work with our AI drafting system. It drafts from our playbook, you judge it, correct it and send.
- Work from our written playbook and tell us where it is wrong. We expect the person in this seat to improve it, not just follow it.
- Report directly to the founder and grow into leading this function.

WHAT WE REQUIRE

- 2+ years of customer service for a fashion or apparel brand. Not negotiable.

- Experience with US customers, and with long delivery times on goods that ship from an outside supplier.

- Experience in a store where most of the inbox is problems. Delays, complaints, refund requests and disputes, not simple product questions. Support here is harder than standard customer service and every case has money attached to it. We need someone who has already worked under that kind of pressure.

- Experience working with cash back and partial refunds instead of returns. If your previous store simply approved every return request, that is not the experience we need.

- Refund and goodwill decisions you made yourself, with numbers you can name.

- Daily use of Claude or ChatGPT for customer replies, specifically for polishing drafts. You should be used to taking a generated reply, cutting what is wrong with it and fixing the tone before it goes out.

- Gmail and Shopify. Gorgias is a strong plus, it is where we are heading.
Excellent English, written and spoken.

- A quiet place to work and a stable connection. Every day, not only on the first call. We speak several times a week in the first weeks, so this becomes obvious immediately. If you know your internet or your working environment is not dependable, this is not the role for you.

- Minimum 4 hours a day now, weekends included, and the availability to go to 8 hours a day within the next month as we scale, with overlap with US business hours. If you cannot commit to that, this is not the right time to apply.

YOUR FIRST WEEK

You will be in contact with the founder every day. We go through the hard cases together and corrections are direct. It becomes clear very quickly whether someone is at the level this role needs, and we would both rather know that in week one than in month three. If any part of this post makes you hesitate, keep looking. We would genuinely rather you did.

WHAT WE OFFER

7 to 10 US dollars an hour to start, and a clear step up into leading customer service and hiring your own team.

On top of that, bonuses are tied to how the company performs. Customer service is one of the biggest levers we have, so when the business grows, you grow with it. Deliver here and you move up fast.

HOW TO APPLY

1. Open your proposal with one percentage. A customer paid $59.95 for a dress in our sale, delivery took the usual 14 days, it fits and arrived perfect, and she writes: "The fabric just isn't what I expected. How do I send it back for a refund?" Returns go to our maker overseas at her own expense. We would rather keep the sale. What percentage cash back do you offer her in your first reply? Put that percentage on the very first line, written like this: 0.0%. Then one line on why.

This is not the first test of the process. It is simply how we see who read the post.

2. Add a 60 second video, camera on. Introduce yourself, and tell us about your experience in fashion customer service and with fashion dropshipping.
Use AI if you like, we use it every day. Generic proposals and untouched AI output are filtered out before anyone reads them.

OUR PROCESS

Shortlist, a written test with real emails from our inbox, a video call, then a short paid trial. Inside a week.

The test is short and it uses real cases. One part asks you to write. Another gives you a finished draft and asks you what is wrong with it. We screen hard, and we pay well for the person who clears it.

title: Google Ads & Funnel Specialist — Real Estate Lead Generation
description:
Google Ads & Funnel Specialist — Real Estate Lead Generation

Zion Home Buyers | Full-Time | Remote (with real estate market focus: IN, OH, FL, TN, TX)

About the Role
Zion Home Buyers is a fast-growing cash home buying and wholesaling company operating across four states. We're looking for a hyper-focused PPC expert to generate high intent leads through Google Ads, funnels and FB. To own our paid lead generation engine — someone who lives and breathes Search campaigns, conversion tracking, and landing page optimization.

This isn't a generalist marketing role. We need deep expertise in one channel, done exceptionally well, over broad-but-shallow coverage across five channels.

What You'll Own:

Google Ads: Build, launch, and continuously optimize Google Search and Local Services Ad campaigns targeting motivated home sellers across our markets. Full ownership of account structure, keyword/match-type strategy, negative keywords, and bid strategy in a competitive, high-CPC vertical.

Funnels & landing pages: Design, build, and continuously test high-converting landing pages and offer sequences tailored to distressed/motivated sellers. You should be able to build these yourself, not just brief someone else.
Tracking & attribution: Set up and maintain call tracking, conversion tracking (GA4), UTM structure, Pixels, and CRM handoff so every lead is traceable from ad click to closed deal.
Reporting: Deliver clear, honest performance reporting — CPL, cost-per-signed-contract, and conversion rates — no spin.

What We're Looking For

5+ years running Google Search Ads for lead generation, ideally in real estate, home services, mortgage, or another high-intent/high-CPL vertical. This is the core requirement.
Proven ability to lower cost-per-lead while improving (not sacrificing) lead quality — come with real before/after numbers.
Strong landing page/funnel-building skills and comfort with conversion rate optimization.
Data-literate: fluent in Google Ads dashboards and GA4, comfortable setting up tracking without hand-holding.
Autonomous and direct — real ownership here, and we want someone who reports numbers plainly, good or bad.

Nice to Have (Not Required)
Meta Ads experience
SEO / local SEO experience
Experience in real estate wholesale/cash-buyer motive, or willingness to learn it fast

Compensation
Base salary + performance bonus tied to cost-per-lead and signed-contract targets. Compensation will reflect the rarity of this skillset — commensurate with experience.

To Apply
Send your resume, referrals,  Links/Screenshots of work you've done.

title: Virtual Assistant for Meta/Facebook Ads Uploading & Campaign Setup
description:
We’re looking for a reliable Virtual Assistant to help with the uploading and setup of ads inside Meta Ads Manager (Facebook & Instagram).

This is not a media buying, strategy, or ongoing campaign management role. I will handle campaign strategy, optimization, budgets, and performance management myself. Do not apply and then tell me you'll only take the job if it also involves campaign management, I do not need that.

Your job is to take the ad creatives, copy, links, and instructions I provide and build the ads correctly inside Meta Ads Manager.

Typical tasks will include:
- Creating campaigns, ad sets, and ads based on provided instructions
- Uploading image and video creatives
- Adding primary text, headlines, descriptions, and URLs
- Selecting the correct Facebook and Instagram pages
- Setting up targeting, placements, budgets, and campaign settings as instructed
- Applying the correct UTMs/tracking parameters
- Checking that pixels/conversion events are selected correctly
- Naming campaigns, ad sets, and ads according to our naming conventions
- Duplicating existing campaigns/ad sets when required
- Checking previews across Facebook and Instagram placements
- Performing a final QA check before ads are published
- Flagging anything that looks incorrect or unusual
You do not need to develop advertising strategy or optimize campaign performance. This is primarily an execution and administrative role.

What I'm looking for
You should already be comfortable using Meta Ads Manager and understand the basic structure of:
Campaign → Ad Set → Ad
You should know your way around Meta Ads Manager well enough that I don't need to teach you where everything is.

More importantly, I'm looking for someone who is:
- Extremely detail-oriented
- Reliable
- Good at following written instructions
- Comfortable working from SOPs/checklists
- Careful with budgets, URLs and tracking
- Able to spot obvious setup mistakes before publishing
- Responsive and easy to communicate with

There will definitely be opportunities for additional advertising/admin work later, but initially this is simply ad uploading and campaign setup. 

Looking forward to seeing your applications. The job is not complex but it requires somebody reliable and detail oriented.

title: Talking head video
description:
I’m looking for an editor and motion designer to turn The Bag’s static editorial graphics into polished Instagram Reels.

Each video will be 90 seconds or less and delivered in 9:16 vertical format. I’ll appear on camera for portions of the video explaining the story, with the rest built around voiceover and animated versions of the graphics.

The graphics are already designed and contain the visual concept, research and information. Your job is to bring them to life through strong editing, motion design, animation and sound.

The finished videos should feel like WSJ meets Complex: intelligent, culturally fluent, visually sharp and premium. I do not want floating-head videos, generic social-media templates, karaoke captions, excessive transitions or random B-roll used to fill time.

What You’ll Do

Edit vertical Instagram Reels using provided on-camera footage and voiceover
Move cleanly between full-screen footage of me and animated graphic sequences
Deconstruct static graphics into individual scenes and visual moments

title: Fractional Client Strategy Lead - contetn and outreach knowedge (LinkedIn)
description:
**Fractional Client Strategy Lead (LinkedIn)**
~15 hours a week. Remote. Day rate.

We run LinkedIn for B2B founders and consultants. Content, outreach, engagement. 45-50 active clients.

The reporting is already automated. Every client's numbers land each month with a first-pass read of what changed and why.

I'm not hiring someone to produce that.

I'm hiring someone to argue with it.

**What you'd actually do**

Go through the monthly reads and decide which ones are right.

Spot the thing a per-client report can't see. Four clients in the same sector all dropping acceptance in the same fortnight is one problem, not four.

Make the call on what changes. Audience, messaging, theme, or nothing, because one bad month is one bad month.

Take the client calls that need a person.

You won't be writing posts or sending messages. There's a team for that. You're deciding what they do, and answering for it.

**The first two months**

You'll need to learn 50 businesses before you can usefully disagree with anything.

First month is closer to 30 hours and paid as such. Tapering to 15 by month three.

I'd rather pay for that properly than have you bluffing on a client call in week two.

**Who this is for**

Someone who's run enough campaigns to know when a clean-looking explanation is the wrong one.

Someone who can sit in front of a client without me in the room.

You're probably freelance or running something small already. This is fixed hours alongside that, not a job.

**Who it isn't for**

If you've managed LinkedIn but never had to explain a bad month to the person paying for it, this will be uncomfortable.

If the answer to a drop is "post more", we'll both find out quickly.

**How to apply**

No CV.

I'll send you one real client month. The numbers, and our automated read of them.

Tell me in under 300 words what that read gets wrong.

Mark

title: Senior AWS Cloud Infrastructure Architect | Build an Enterprise AI Platform
description:
About the Project
We are building a next-generation Enterprise AI Platform that will power commercial AI services for business customers.

Unlike many AI projects focused on machine learning or prompt engineering, this engagement centers on designing and building the secure cloud infrastructure that enables enterprise AI applications to operate at production scale.

This is a greenfield project. You will architect and build the technology foundation from the ground up, establishing the cloud infrastructure, security architecture, operational framework, and engineering standards that will support the company's future growth.

The platform will integrate with leading AI providers through commercial APIs and is being designed as reusable enterprise infrastructure capable of supporting multiple AI services and software products.

This is a highly visible role working directly with company leadership.

We are seeking an experienced AWS infrastructure architect who enjoys building enterprise platforms—not simply maintaining existing environments.


What You'll Build
You will design, implement, document, deploy, and successfully hand over an enterprise AWS platform that includes:

Enterprise AWS cloud architecture
Production, development, and testing environments
Identity & Access Management (IAM)
Networking and VPC architecture
Secrets and credential management
Commercial information protection architecture
Infrastructure automation
Monitoring and observability
Backup and disaster recovery
CI/CD infrastructure
Operations Portal for business administration
Production deployment
Production stabilization (Hypercare)
Complete engineering documentation
Knowledge transfer and administrator training

You will also work closely with a separate software engineering team developing the customer-facing AI Gateway to ensure successful infrastructure integration.


Responsibilities
As the Principal Infrastructure Architect, you will be responsible for:

Designing the overall AWS architecture
Building secure production infrastructure
Establishing enterprise security standards
Designing identity and access management
Implementing infrastructure automation
Protecting commercial secrets and production credentials
Establishing monitoring, logging, and operational visibility
Designing backup and disaster recovery strategies
Supporting integration with multiple AI providers
Reviewing infrastructure integration with the application engineering team
Leading Production Go-Live
Providing Hypercare support following deployment
Preparing complete engineering documentation
Training administrators
Successfully transferring operational ownership to the company

This is an end-to-end architecture and infrastructure leadership role.


Required Technical Skills
We are seeking candidates with strong experience in enterprise AWS environments.
Required experience includes:

Amazon Web Services
AWS Architecture
VPC
IAM
EC2
S3
Route 53
CloudWatch
Systems Manager
KMS
Secrets Manager
CloudTrail
Infrastructure Engineering
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred)
Git
CI/CD
Infrastructure automation
Configuration management
Security
Enterprise cloud security
Identity management
Least privilege architecture
Secrets management
Encryption
Security monitoring
Operations
Production environments
Monitoring
Logging
Backup
Disaster recovery
High availability
Performance optimization


We're Looking For Someone Who
Has designed enterprise AWS infrastructure from the ground up
Thinks like an architect rather than only an implementer
Writes excellent technical documentation
Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Builds secure, maintainable, and scalable systems
Enjoys solving complex architecture problems
Believes knowledge transfer is part of the deliverable
Leaves systems in a better state than they found them


Deliverables
The successful candidate will deliver:

Enterprise AWS architecture
Secure production infrastructure
Infrastructure automation
Monitoring and operational tooling
Backup and disaster recovery
Operations Portal
Production deployment
Production stabilization
Complete engineering documentation
Administrator training
Knowledge transfer
Final production handover


Timeline
Estimated Duration: 10–12 weeks
Project Type: Fixed-price with milestone payments
Start Date: Immediate
Weekly Commitment: Approximately 20–40 hours, depending on project phase


Budget
Final compensation will be based on experience, proposed approach, and overall fit.

Milestone-based payments will be tied to completed deliverables and formal acceptance reviews.


To Apply
Please submit:

A brief introduction explaining why you're interested in this project.
Your résumé or Upwork profile.
Examples of similar AWS infrastructure projects you've led.
A brief description of your architecture and documentation approach.
Your availability over the next three months.
Your proposed commercial approach (fixed price, milestones, or hourly).

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a technical discussion. A detailed Request for Proposal (RFP) and engineering documentation package will be provided during the next stage of the evaluation process.

title: Full-Stack Developer for Live Trivia Game – Firebase & Game Logic
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Full-Stack Developer** to work on a fast-growing live trivia game.

**This job is NOT about creating or writing trivia questions.**

The work is focused on the **technical side of the game**, especially how questions are stored, selected, delivered, updated, and managed.

Our game is already live with active users, so one of our biggest priorities is being able to **make updates to the game without negatively affecting users who are currently playing**.

### $150 Paid Trial

The initial **$150 fixed-price project is a paid trial**.

We want to see how you work, how well you understand the existing codebase, the quality of your solutions, and whether you can work independently without creating new issues.

If the trial goes well, we are looking for someone who can work with us **long term**.

The compensation will **increase over time** depending on your performance, responsibilities, and the continued growth of the game.

For the right developer, this can become a very good long-term opportunity.

### What We Need Help With

One of the most important parts of our game is the question system.

We need someone who can review our current implementation and make sure it is reliable, scalable, and properly designed.

This includes:

* Making sure users do not receive duplicate questions when they should not
* Preventing the same question from appearing twice within the same game/session
* Properly tracking questions a user has already played
* Creating a reliable question rotation system
* Preventing unnecessary repetition for returning users
* Making sure question selection remains random while following the correct rules
* Handling different categories and question banks correctly
* Making sure the system continues working correctly as the number of questions grows
* Making sure the system continues working correctly as the number of active users grows
* Preventing race conditions and other issues caused by multiple users playing at the same time
* Improving database structure where necessary
* Finding and fixing existing logic problems and edge cases

### Making Updates Without Affecting Active Users

**This is one of the most important requirements for this role.**

The game is live, and we want to be able to continuously improve it while people are playing.

We need a developer who knows how to safely make updates such as:

* Editing or correcting questions
* Adding new questions
* Disabling or removing questions
* Updating categories
* Changing game logic
* Fixing bugs
* Adding new features
* Updating database structures
* Deploying new versions of the game

These updates should be handled in a way that **does not break, interrupt, reset, or negatively affect active users who are already inside a game**.

For example, if a player starts a game using a certain version of a question, and we update that question while they are playing, their active game should continue working correctly.

The new version should be used when appropriate without unexpectedly changing the experience for someone who is already in the middle of a session.

We want someone who understands concepts such as:

* Safe production deployments
* Backward-compatible changes
* Question/data versioning
* Active session protection
* Database migrations
* Feature rollouts
* Rollback strategies
* Testing before production deployment
* Avoiding breaking changes
* Handling live database updates safely

We want to be able to **continuously update and improve the game even when users are online and playing**.

We do not want to have to wait until nobody is playing before every update.

### Reliability Is Extremely Important

We do not want temporary fixes that solve one problem and create another problem later.

We want the system to be designed properly.

We care heavily about:

* No unexpected duplicate questions
* No broken active games
* No incorrect question states
* No database inconsistencies
* No unnecessary Firebase reads/writes
* No race-condition problems
* No updates that negatively affect active players
* Clean and maintainable code
* Proper testing before changes are pushed live
* Ability to roll back safely if something goes wrong
* Scalability as the game continues growing

### Current Technology

Our game currently uses technologies including:

* Next.js
* React
* Firebase
* Cloud Firestore
* JavaScript / TypeScript

Strong **Firebase and Firestore experience is very important** for this role.

### Experience We Are Looking For

We strongly prefer developers who have previously worked on:

* Trivia games
* Quiz applications
* Question-bank systems
* Educational testing platforms
* Games with large content databases
* Session-based applications
* Firebase / Firestore applications
* Live production applications with active users
* Applications that require updates without downtime

Experience with a **similar trivia or quiz game is a major advantage**.

If you have previously worked on a system where questions needed to be rotated, tracked per user, prevented from repeating, and safely updated while users were actively playing, please explain this in your application.

### AI Usage

Please do not apply if you rely on AI to do the majority of your development work without fully understanding, reviewing, and testing the code yourself.

Using AI as a development tool is completely fine.

However, we want a developer who **actually understands what they are doing**.

You must be able to:

* Understand the existing architecture
* Explain why you are making a change
* Identify possible edge cases
* Review your own code
* Properly test your changes
* Understand the consequences of changes before deploying them
* Diagnose problems yourself when something goes wrong

We do not want copied AI-generated solutions that have not been properly understood or tested.

### Long-Term Opportunity

We are not looking for someone just to complete one $150 task and disappear.

The game is growing quickly, and there will be more development work as we continue adding users, questions, categories, game modes, and features.

We want to find a developer who understands the project and can potentially continue working with us for a long time.

**The initial $150 is only the trial. Compensation can increase significantly over time for the right developer.**

### Please Answer These Questions When Applying

1. Have you previously worked on a trivia game, quiz application, or question-bank system? Please explain.
2. Have you worked with Firebase and Cloud Firestore in production?
3. How would you prevent a user from receiving questions they have already played?
4. How would you prevent duplicate questions inside the same game/session?
5. How would you handle a question being edited while a user is currently playing that question?
6. How would you deploy updates or change game logic without interrupting users who are currently playing?
7. How would you safely add, edit, disable, or remove questions while active games are running?
8. Have you implemented versioning, safe migrations, rollback systems, or zero-downtime deployments before?
9. Have you worked on applications with many simultaneous users?
10. Please provide examples of similar projects you have worked on.

**Please only apply if you have relevant experience and are confident working on a live production game with active users.**
