title: SaaS Account Manager – Customer Onboarding, Technical Support & QA
description:
SaaS Account Manager – Customer Onboarding, Technical Support & QA

We are looking for a highly capable SaaS Account Manager / Customer Success & Technical Support Specialist to join an early-stage software business as we begin onboarding and scaling customers.

We have developed a comprehensive booking and business management platform designed particularly for businesses providing mobile and location-based services.

The platform manages areas including:

* Online bookings
* Services and service configuration
* Staff/providers
* Availability and scheduling
* Service areas and travel zones
* Customer management
* User roles and permissions
* Payments and payment integrations
* Business settings
* Notifications
* Integrations
* Mobile service delivery workflows
* Business knowledge and operational settings

The platform is technically advanced and highly configurable. We therefore need someone who can become an expert in the system and act as the bridge between our customers, product team and developers.

The Role

This is not a traditional customer service position.

You will become one of the key people responsible for helping businesses successfully implement and operate our platform.

Initially, you will work closely with the founders and development team to learn the platform in detail.

Over time, we want you to take ownership of the majority of customer onboarding, account management and Level 1/Level 2 support.

Your goal is to make it possible for us to onboard and support significantly more customers without every question or issue needing to go directly to the founders or developers.

1. Customer Onboarding

You will guide new businesses through the complete setup of their account.

This may include:

* Understanding how the customer’s business operates
* Creating/configuring their organisation
* Setting up services
* Setting up staff/providers
* Configuring availability and scheduling
* Configuring service areas and travel settings
* Setting up users, roles and permissions
* Assisting with payment and other integrations
* Reviewing business-specific settings
* Testing the setup before launch
* Training business owners and managers
* Helping customers successfully move into live operation

You should be comfortable speaking with a non-technical business owner, understanding what they are trying to achieve and translating that into the correct system configuration.

Customers may not always know which settings they require. Part of your job will be to ask the right questions and recommend the appropriate configuration.

2. Customer Account Management

You will become a trusted point of contact for customers using the platform.

Rather than simply answering questions, we want you to understand:

* How their business operates
* How they are using our platform
* What they are trying to achieve
* Where they are experiencing friction
* Whether the platform is configured correctly
* Whether additional features or improvements could help them

As customers expand their businesses, you may also assist with additional locations, providers, services or new workflows.

3. Technical Support & Ticket Management

You will manage incoming customer support requests through our support/ticketing system.

Responsibilities will include:

* Responding to customer questions
* Troubleshooting issues
* Reproducing reported problems
* Determining whether an issue is user error, configuration-related or a genuine software bug
* Resolving Level 1 and Level 2 issues where possible
* Creating clear technical tickets for developers when escalation is required
* Adding screenshots, screen recordings and reproduction steps
* Prioritising issues appropriately
* Following tickets through to resolution
* Communicating progress back to customers
* Confirming that fixes work before closing tickets

We do not want developers spending significant time responding to basic customer questions.

Your role will be to filter, investigate and clearly define issues before they reach development.

4. QA & Product Testing

Particularly while our customer base is growing, there will be periods where support volume is lower.

During these periods, you will assist with QA and platform testing.

This may include:

* Testing new releases
* Testing customer workflows
* Trying to break workflows before customers find problems
* Reproducing reported bugs
* Regression testing fixes
* Testing different user roles and permissions
* Testing booking and scheduling scenarios
* Testing integrations
* Confirming development tickets have been resolved correctly

We want someone who naturally thinks:

“What happens if the customer does this?”

rather than simply testing the expected path.

5. Customer Feedback → Product Improvement

We are still actively developing and improving the platform.

Early customers will therefore play an important role in shaping the product.

You will help capture feedback such as:

* “I don’t understand this setting.”
* “How do I do this?”
* “Why can’t I do this?”
* “This workflow is confusing.”
* “It would be easier if the system did this.”
* “Our business operates differently.”

You will identify recurring themes and communicate them clearly to the product and development team.

Not every customer request should become a feature.

We need someone capable of distinguishing between:

Support issue → Configuration issue → UX problem → Bug → Feature request → Product opportunity.

6. Documentation & Knowledge Base

You will help us continuously improve our customer documentation and support knowledge base.

When the same question appears repeatedly, we don’t want to answer it manually forever.

You will help create and maintain:

* Setup guides
* Onboarding checklists
* FAQs
* Help articles
* Short training instructions
* Video walkthrough requirements
* Troubleshooting guides
* Internal support procedures

Over time, we intend to use this knowledge base with AI-assisted customer support to resolve simple questions automatically, while human support remains available for more complex issues.

What We’re Looking For

Ideally, you have experience in one or more of the following:

* SaaS Account Management
* Customer Success
* SaaS onboarding/implementation
* Technical customer support
* Help desk/ticket management
* Software QA/testing
* Booking or scheduling platforms
* CRM/business management software

You do not need to be a software developer.

However, you must be technically confident and comfortable learning a reasonably complex software platform.

You Will Be a Great Fit If You:

* Learn software quickly
* Are comfortable exploring a system independently
* Are extremely organised
* Can manage multiple customers and tickets
* Communicate clearly with non-technical users
* Can explain technical concepts in simple language
* Are comfortable working directly with developers
* Can reproduce and clearly document software bugs
* Think logically when troubleshooting
* Have strong attention to detail
* Can conduct online onboarding/training sessions
* Take ownership of problems rather than simply forwarding them
* Understand the difference between a bug, support question and feature request
* Enjoy working with an evolving product
* Are interested in growing with an early-stage SaaS business

Language

Excellent written and spoken English is essential.

Additional languages, particularly Bahasa Indonesia, would be highly regarded as we expect Indonesia/Bali to be an important early market.

However, strong English and technical/customer-management ability are more important than location.

Tools

Experience with tools such as the following would be beneficial:

* Zendesk or similar support platforms
* Jira / Linear / Plane or similar ticket systems
* Slack
* Notion or other knowledge-base systems
* Loom
* CRM systems
* ChatGPT / AI support tools
* Google Workspace
* Payment and API integrations

Specific tools can be taught. We care more about your ability to understand the overall workflow.

How This Role Can Grow

We are looking for someone who can grow with the business.

Initially, you may personally handle onboarding, account management, support and QA for a relatively small number of customers.

As we scale, we would like this person to potentially become a:

Senior Account Manager / Customer Success & Support Lead

and eventually help us:

* Develop our onboarding processes
* Build our customer support procedures
* Establish support SLAs
* Improve our knowledge base
* Train additional support staff
* Manage a growing support team
* Identify product improvements from customer feedback
* Help us onboard customers across multiple countries

We want to build the processes now that could eventually support dozens and ultimately hundreds of businesses.

Initial Objective

Your first objective will be to learn the platform thoroughly and work with us to onboard and support our initial live customers.

We will deliberately use these early customers to identify:

1. Where customers struggle during onboarding
2. Which parts of the platform are confusing
3. What questions customers repeatedly ask
4. What should be improved in the user interface
5. What should become documentation or training
6. What needs to be escalated to development

The goal isn’t simply to answer support tickets.

The goal is to help us build an onboarding and customer-support operation that can scale.

When Applying

Please include:

1. Your experience onboarding customers onto SaaS/software platforms.
2. Your experience managing technical support tickets.
3. An example of a complex software product you have had to learn.
4. Your experience working directly with developers.
5. Whether you have performed QA/software testing.
6. Which help-desk/ticketing systems you have used.
7. Your spoken and written English level.
8. Any additional languages you speak.
9. Your location and timezone.
10. Your current availability per week.

Please also answer this scenario:

A customer tells you: “The booking system isn’t working.” What steps would you take before escalating the issue to a developer?

We are particularly interested in your answer to this question because we are looking for someone who can investigate, troubleshoot and take ownership, rather than simply forwarding every customer message to the development team.

title: Easy Mystery Shopping Opportunity - Iasi/Romania
description:
Summary
In this assignment you have to visit a beauty store (not just for ladies!!!) and evaluate the customer interaction and service quality.

You enter the store and if you are not approached by an employee within 15 minutes, you approach one yourself. If you are a new customer at this store, the employee should help you discover the brand and invite you to try products. They should introduce you to a 3-product ritual consisting of bath, body and household products.

If you are already a customer, the employee should first help you with your initial needs. After satisfying your initial needs, the employee should offer you a new product experience to offer you one or more additional products.

The interaction should feel compelling so that you feel comfortable and have a positive experience.

You don't have to buy any of the recommended products, but you do have to make a purchase (worth MINIMUM € 20).

The purchase of your choice must exceed the value of €20 (can also be €20.99), but you can spend more. You will receive up to MAX €22 back from us. If you spend less than €20, your report cannot be accepted. If you spend more than € 22,-, the amount above the € 22,- you will have to cover yourself.

VISIT MUST BE CONDUCTED IN Romanian!

Photos required: Exterior view of the store and your receipt.

After your visit, fill in an online questionnaire.

Location: Iasi, Romania

Payment:
5,- € for filling in the questionnaire
max € 22,- for your purchase
TOTAL: 27 € ,-

DEADLINE: August 26 th!!!

title: Video Editor & Reels Creator (Arabic Content)
description:
We’re Hiring: Video Editor & Reels Creator (Arabic Content)

We’re looking for a creative and detail-oriented Video Editor to join our team.

If you’re passionate about creating engaging, cinematic short-form content and know how to make videos go viral, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

* Edit Instagram Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts from raw footage.
* Create fast-paced, cinematic edits with smooth transitions and engaging storytelling.
* Add professional motion graphics, sound effects, music, and visual enhancements.
* Generate accurate English subtitles from Arabic-speaking videos.
* Optimize videos for maximum engagement and retention.
* Deliver high-quality content on schedule.

Requirements

* Strong experience with Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve.
* Experience editing viral short-form content.
* Must understand spoken Arabic.
* Excellent English skills for creating subtitles.
* Creative eye for pacing, hooks, and cinematic storytelling.
* Portfolio of previous Reels or Shorts is required.

Preferred

* Experience with health, fitness, or lifestyle content.
* Familiarity with Instagram and TikTok trends.

📩 To apply, send your CV, portfolio, and 3–5 sample Reels you’ve edited.

title: Mongolian-Speaking Motorcycle Market Researcher
description:
Mongolia KTM Fleet Commercial Research: Pricing, Rental, Used Fleet & Fleet Economics


Project Overview

I am building a premium motorcycle expedition company preparing to launch guided off-road expeditions in Mongolia in 2027. We are currently determining the most commercially sensible way to secure a fleet of 8–12 KTM 450 EXC-F motorcycles for the first operating season.

This project is specifically focused on Mongolia.

The objective is NOT to conduct broad internet research or identify multiple KTM distributors. We already understand that Storm Motors / KTM Mongolia is the official KTM distributor in Mongolia.

Instead, I need a Mongolian-speaking researcher to conduct direct local enquiries and obtain REAL COMMERCIAL INFORMATION from the relevant companies and fleet owners.

The final output should allow us to compare three realistic options:

1. Purchase a new KTM fleet from KTM Mongolia and understand financing / leasing options
2. Purchase suitable used/ex-tour KTM motorcycles locally
3. Rent or lease a KTM fleet for the 2027 operating season
4. Other options you may uncover

----------


Workstream 1 — Storm Motors / KTM Mongolia

Contact Storm Motors / KTM Mongolia directly.

We are currently evaluating an initial fleet of 8–12 KTM enduro motorcycles and are assessing fleet pricing, servicing and commercial arrangements.

Please establish the appropriate commercial decision-maker and obtain information directly from them.

Required pricing

Request quotations for:

* 6 × KTM 450 EXC-F
* 8 × KTM 450 EXC-F
* 10 × KTM 450 EXC-F
* 12 × KTM 450 EXC-F

Also obtain comparison pricing for:

* KTM 450 EXC-F Six Days
* available 2026 stock
* incoming 2027 models
* other enduro models which may be discounted to clear


Commercial questions

Please establish:
* Retail price per motorcycle
* Commercial/fleet price
* Quantity discount at 6 / 8 / 10 / 12 units
* Availability of existing 2026 /27 inventory
* Whether outgoing model-year motorcycles can receive additional discounts
* Expected arrival date of 2027 models
* Deposit required
* Timing of final payment
* Whether staged payments are possible
* Whether installment financing is available
* Whether deferred payment is possible for a commercial tourism operator
* Whether any leasing or lease-to-own option exists
* Whether KTM Mongolia would consider a predetermined trade-in or buyback arrangement after 1–2 seasons


Warranty and servicing

Please establish:
* Standard warranty
* Whether commercial tour use affects the warranty
* Registration costs
* Delivery/preparation charges
* Workshop labour rates
* Recommended service intervals for heavy expedition use
* Typical servicing cost
* Availability of KTM spare parts in Mongolia
* Whether fleet customers receive preferential parts pricing
* Recommended spare-parts inventory for a fleet of 10 motorcycles
* Approximate cost of this spare-parts package


Fleet partnership

Please specifically ask whether KTM Mongolia would be interested in establishing the business as a commercial fleet / expedition partner.

Possible areas to discuss:
* preferential fleet pricing
* service support
* parts support
* annual fleet replacement
* trade-in
* deferred/staged payment
* brand or marketing partnership

We are not asking for sponsorship as the primary enquiry. We should be presented first as a serious potential commercial fleet customer.

---

Workstream 2 — Probike / Gobatar / Others..  Mongolia KTM Fleet

Please research companies which currently operate KTM 450 EXC and similar motorcycles for motorcycle tours.The goal is to understand their fleet and whether any commercial opportunity exists.

Please establish, as far as reasonably possible:
* Approximate number of KTM motorcycles in their fleet
* Exact models
* Approximate model years
* Whether they own the motorcycles
* Where the motorcycles were originally purchased/imported from
* How frequently the fleet is replaced
* What happens to motorcycles when they leave the fleet
* Whether they sells ex-tour motorcycles
* Whether any bikes may become available before the 2027 riding season
* Approximate historical or expected sale prices
* Whether they would consider renting/subleasing motorcycles B2B to another operator during periods when they are not required

Initial fact-finding should be discreet without revealing the company. If a genuine commercial opportunity appears to exist, more information can then be disclosed and a formal enquiry made once I have approved. 

---

# Workstream 3 — Fleet Financing / Leasing Options in Mongolia

Please investigate realistic financing, leasing and deferred-payment options available in Mongolia for a newly established commercial tourism company seeking to acquire approximately 8–12 KTM 450 EXC-F motorcycles.

The objective is to determine whether Frontier could reduce the upfront cash requirement for the fleet rather than purchasing all motorcycles outright.

Please identify and contact relevant:
* commercial banks
* leasing companies
* non-bank financial institutions
* vehicle/equipment finance providers
* dealer-linked finance providers
* business lending providers

Please establish whether motorcycles can qualify as financed commercial assets.

For each credible provider, please obtain:
* Company/provider name
* Relevant contact person
* Type of product offered
* Whether motorcycles are eligible
* Whether off-road/enduro motorcycles are eligible
* Whether a newly established company can apply
* Minimum company operating history required
* Whether audited financial statements are required
* Minimum revenue requirements
* Founder/director personal guarantee requirements
* Collateral requirements
* Minimum deposit/down payment
* Maximum percentage financed
* Financing term
* Indicative interest rate
* Arrangement/origination fees
* Monthly repayment structure
* Early repayment penalties
* Whether the motorcycles themselves can serve as collateral
* Whether foreign-owned companies are eligible
* Whether a foreign shareholder/director creates additional requirements
* Whether the company must be Mongolian-owned
* Whether finance can be used for motorcycles purchased through Storm Motors
* Whether imported motorcycles can also be financed

Please specifically model financing for an indicative fleet purchase of:

**10 × KTM 450 EXC-F**

and obtain, where possible:

* required upfront deposit
* amount financed
* monthly payment
* total interest/finance cost
* term
* security/collateral required

Please distinguish clearly between:

1. Traditional loan financing
2. Finance lease / lease-to-own
3. Operating lease
4. Dealer instalment/deferred-payment arrangements

If no true motorcycle fleet leasing products exist in Mongolia, please confirm this clearly rather than assuming leasing is available.

The key question that needs answered is:

Can a newly established company realistically secure 8–12 motorcycles while paying only part of the purchase price upfront?

Please provide documentary evidence or direct provider responses wherever possible.

---

Workstream 4 — Used KTM Fleet Market

Please identify credible opportunities to purchase 2024–2026 KTM 450 EXC / EXC-F motorcycles already located in Mongolia.

Priority should be given to:
* ex-tour bikes
* professionally maintained fleet bikes
* low-owner bikes
* motorcycles with documented maintenance history

This is not intended to be a generic classified-ad search. I want to understand whether there is a realistic opportunity to purchase a group of motorcycles, ideally 4–10 units, from an operator or fleet owner.

* seller

* expected availability

Please speak with relevant KTM mechanics, fleet operators and/or Storm Motors to obtain realistic estimates for the annual operating costs of a KTM 450 EXC-F used for guided motorcycle expeditions in Mongolia.

10 commercial expeditions annually (15,000km per bike per year)

Please distinguish between:

normal scheduled maintenance

reasonable annual repair/damage allowance.

If possible, please ask Storm Motors approximately:

Which tourism or commercial operators operate the largest KTM fleets?
Are there other significant KTM fleet owners we should know about?

Exact confidential sales figures are not required. Approximate market intelligence is sufficient.

I can provide the current completed video and original footage if required.

title: Looking for a Hong Kong Lawyer to Help Me Recover My Company Shares From a Nominee
description:
About me and my situation

Hi, I am a Dutch entrepreneur running e-commerce businesses, and I am looking for a Hong Kong lawyer to help me recover full legal ownership of a Hong Kong company. In 2024 I set up a Hong Kong private limited company. Because I am not a Hong Kong resident, a nominee was arranged to act as the registered director and shareholder on my behalf.

I have this properly documented. I hold a signed nominee agreement and a signed transfer of shares with her, and a further signed agreement between us dated 16 December 2025. I paid her a one-time nominee fee of EUR 1,000. She never contributed any capital and never paid a single cent toward the company. I paid for the incorporation and every company fee since, the company email and bank account have been mine from day one, and every business decision over more than two years was mine. I have all the documents and the full evidence pack organised and ready to share.

Since around that time the nominee has disappeared and I have no direct contact with her. Her identity and name are now being used by a counterparty in an ongoing international arbitration I am involved in, through a connected intermediary. Because of this I need to secure my ownership and get the register cleaned up.

What I am asking you to do

My strong preference is to resolve this through the ownership evidence and the nominee agreement, not through a long court fight. As a first step I would like a written advice: how strong my ownership position is on the documents and payment trail, the best route to confirm me as the true owner and correct the register of members (I understand this may involve a resulting trust and rectification under the Companies Ordinance), and what protective steps are available so the shares cannot be dealt with in the meantime. Please also give a realistic view of timeline and cost.

Please note the company is the claimant in an ongoing international arbitration with its own counsel; nothing will be filed in Hong Kong before the timing is aligned with him, and you would coordinate with him. Nothing gets filed without my explicit go-ahead. I will share all names and documents after an NDA and a conflict check. I am based in Asia (GMT+8), responsive and easy to work with, and would like your first written advice within about 7 to 10 days.

A few questions when you apply

Are you a Hong Kong qualified lawyer, and at which firm?
Have you handled a nominee shareholder or beneficial ownership dispute, or a rectification of the register of members? Tell me briefly about one example.
What would you charge as a fixed fee for the written advice, and your hourly rate for any work after that?

title: Experienced Shipping Partner Needed — China to USA | Pet Supplements
description:
We’re an established e-commerce pet supplement brand looking for an experienced shipping/logistics partner for regular shipments from China to customers across the USA.

Shipment Details

* Product: Pet supplements in small plastic tubs (70–90g each)
* Typical parcel: 3–6 tubs / approximately 300–700g
* Main destination: USA
* Target delivery: 10–12 days door-to-door
* Consistent monthly order volume

Who We’re Looking For

We only want to work with experienced partners who already handle pet supplements, animal food, or similar FDA-regulated products shipping from China to the USA.

You should:

* Have proven experience with this product category
* Work with a licensed U.S. customs broker
* Be able to handle FDA Prior Notice
* Understand current U.S. customs/tariff requirements
* Provide transparent pricing, including shipping, customs/clearance, duties, last-mile delivery, and other fees

Trial & Long-Term Opportunity

We’ll shortlist 2–3 qualified partners for a paid 4-week trial using real customer orders. The best-performing partner can receive our ongoing shipping volume.

To Apply

Please send:

1. Company name + website
2. Your experience shipping pet supplements/animal food to the USA
3. One real example of a similar client/product you handle
4. Estimated cost for a 0.5kg parcel to the USA, with a clear cost breakdown

Please apply only if you already have relevant China-to-USA shipping experience.

title: GoHighLevel (GHL) Specialist | Full System Build & ServiceM8 Integration
description:
We are seeking an experienced GoHighLevel (GHL) expert to build our sales and automation engine from scratch. You will handle complete technical setup, pipeline architecture, legacy CRM data migration, and seamless integration with the ServiceM8 Marketplace App.
Project Scope & Core Responsibilities
•	Technical Foundations & Compliance: Configure primary/subdomains for email sending, set up LC Email with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC compliance, and port/configure an existing 0800 phone number via LC Phone/Twilio ensuring full A2P 10DLC compliance.
•	Funnel & Source Tracking: Embed GHL forms/surveys into our existing imported landing page. Implement attribution tracking (UTM parameters/custom fields) to differentiate leads between Facebook Ads and organic web traffic.
•	Data Migration (Capsule CRM to GHL): Review, clean, and map legacy data exports from Capsule CRM. Import contacts with relevant tags, custom fields, and past service history (e.g., last service date and recurring 1-, 2-, or 3-year service due dates).
•	Pipelines & Booking Systems: Build a streamlined sales pipeline for real-time visibility on all opportunities. Set up a GHL telephone booking calendar for sales calls.
•	Automation & Follow-Up Workflows: Build multi-channel (Email/SMS) workflows for:
o	Immediate follow-up for new inbound Meta and website leads.
o	Nurture sequences for unresponsive/unreachable prospects.
o	Automated quote follow-up campaigns running until a definitive "Yes" or "No" decision is made.
•	ServiceM8 Marketplace Integration: Install and configure the ServiceM8 app from the GHL Marketplace. Establish a clear operational handoff where GHL manages lead intake, tracking, and quote wins, while ServiceM8 handles job dispatching, field scheduling, site photos, and appointment notifications.
Key Qualifications
•	Proven track record building GHL instances from scratch (work samples required).
•	Direct experience integrating GHL with external marketplace apps, ideally ServiceM8.
•	Deep expertise in CRM data migration, custom field mapping, and tagging hygiene.
•	Strong knowledge of A2P 10DLC registration and email deliverability compliance.
To Apply: Please share 2–3 examples of GHL systems you have built, specifically highlighting any past work involving Capsule CRM migrations, attribution tracking, or ServiceM8 integrations.

title: Amazon listing images and A+ Content Designer
description:
IMPORTANT: NO AI-GENERATED IMAGES AT ALL.
Please do not apply if your workflow relies on Midjourney, DALL-E, Firefly, AI-generated backgrounds, AI product renders, AI bees/flowers, or any other generative imagery.

We need a skilled designer in photoshop to create Amazon A+ Content images/banners for a premium New Zealand honey brand.

Scope

* 7 images / approx. 10 banners
* First sample needed ASAP
* If the sample matches the brand direction, we will proceed with the rest immediately

The brand is very strict about its visual identity. The imagery must feel authentic, organic, natural, premium and refined. This is an absolute priority.

Use only:

* Real photography
* Supplied brand/product assets
* Properly licensed stock photography where needed
* Professional Photoshop/compositing

One important banner explains the brand’s sustainability ecosystem:

Bees → Beeswax → Plastic-Free Jar → Honey → Plant the Seed Lid → Wildflowers → Bees

We will provide the product assets, copy and detailed banner direction.

Looking for someone with:

* Strong Amazon A+ / e-commerce design experience
* Excellent Photoshop and compositing skills
* Premium food / organic / natural brand experience
* Strong typography and clean layouts
* Fast turnaround and good communication

Please send 2–4 relevant examples of premium food, organic, wellness or sustainability-focused e-commerce work.

Budget: approx. $12 per image.

Need someone who can start immediately.

title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer – Calm Retirement Finance Channel
description:
I’m launching a US retirement finance YouTube channel for viewers aged 55–75 and looking for a thumbnail designer for ongoing work, around 1–2 videos per week, with 2-3 thumbnail variants per video for A/B testing.

The direction

We’re going for a calm, premium, and trustworthy look rather than typical finance clickbait.

The thumbnails should be:

-Visually simple and easy to understand at a glance
-Built around a strong visual idea, number, comparison, or other clear focal point
-Professional and eye-catching without feeling overly dramatic
- Based on realistic people and visuals where appropriate

I’ll provide a short brief and references for each video, along with a brand kit and a frozen character reference ("Tom"). When Tom is used, his likeness needs to remain consistent.

Within that direction, I’m happy for you to use your own creativity and design judgment.

What I need
- Strong Photoshop/compositing skills and/or experience with AI image generation
- Final thumbnails should look professional and photorealistic, not obviously AI-generated
- Layered source files (PSD or equivalent) so text and elements can be adjusted for testing
- Good readability at small sizes


To apply, please include:

- 2–3 examples of thumbnails you've created for retirement, personal finance, finance, or similar educational content

title: Promotional Booth Video for Exhibition
description:
Create a Premium 60–75 Second Looping Promotional Video for Jewelry Software Company

## Job Description

We are looking for an experienced **motion graphics / promotional video designer** to create a high-quality **60–75 second looping video** that will be displayed continuously on a large screen at our booth during the **Istanbul Jewelry Show**.

Our company, **22-Soft**, develops **22-Gold**, a specialized ERP and management solution built for the gold and jewelry industry.

The video should immediately attract visitors walking past the booth and clearly communicate that 22-Gold is a complete jewelry business solution combining:

* Desktop ERP
* Mobile Application
* RFID Technology
* Inventory Management
* Sales & POS
* Accounting
* Jewelry-specific management
* Retail, Wholesale, Workshops & Factories

The video will mostly be watched without sound, so the story needs to be communicated through strong visuals, motion graphics, short text, product UI, and smooth transitions.

# Style We Are Looking For

The overall look should be:

* Premium and professional
* Modern technology-focused
* Suitable for the luxury jewelry industry
* Elegant dark/gold visual direction
* Clean and minimal
* Strong typography
* Smooth motion graphics and transitions
* Visually impressive on a large exhibition screen

We do not want a typical corporate slideshow with simple transitions.

We want something that feels like a professional technology product advertisement suitable for an international jewelry exhibition.

## Video Structure

We already have a general script/storyboard that includes:

**1. Brand Introduction**
22-Gold — Jewelry ERP & Management System

**2. Complete Jewelry Business Management**
Sales, Inventory, Accounting and Management

**3. Industry Segments**
Retail • Wholesale • Workshops • Factories

**4. Jewelry-Specific Features**
Weight, Karat, Gold Weight, Labor, Cost and Pricing

**5. RFID Technology**
Fast jewelry inventory and stocktaking

**6. Mobile Application**
Access to business information from mobile devices

**7. Connected Ecosystem**
Desktop + Mobile + RFID

**8. Business Insights**
Sales → Inventory → Accounting → Reports

**9. Final Branding / Call to Action**

The ending should transition naturally back into the beginning so the video can **loop continuously without an obvious stop**.

## Materials We Can Provide

We can provide:

* 22-Gold logo and branding
* Screenshots/video recordings of the desktop application
* Mobile application screenshots/recordings
* RFID product images/videos where available
* Product information
* Existing website/marketing materials
* Detailed video script and scene structure

The freelancer will be responsible for transforming these materials into a polished final promotional video.

## Deliverables

Final delivery should include:

* 60–75 second promotional video
* Seamless looping version
* 4K version preferred
* Full HD version
* MP4 / H.264 version suitable for exhibition screens
* Version with background music
* Version without audio
* Editable/source project files

## Freelancer Requirements

We are looking for someone with strong experience in:

* Motion graphics
* Product promotional videos
* SaaS/software promotional videos
* UI animation
* Adobe After Effects / Premiere Pro or equivalent
* Professional typography and transitions
* Luxury/premium visual design

Experience creating content for **trade shows, exhibitions, technology companies, or luxury brands** is a strong advantage.

## When Applying

Please include:

1. Examples of your best promotional or motion graphics videos.
2. Examples of SaaS/software product videos if available.
3. Any previous work created for exhibitions or large booth displays.
4. The software you will use to create the video.
5. Confirmation that you can provide the editable source files.

Please start your proposal with the word **“22-Gold”** so we know you have read the complete job description.

We are looking for someone who can take our existing product, branding, UI and script and turn them into a **premium exhibition video that catches attention within the first few seconds**.

title: AI Automated reports and recommendations for Pilates studio chain
description:
I own a small chain of Pilates studios and have a very small team. I'm trying to extract myself from the day to day business but am finding it difficult to stay on top of staff and don't want to drop the ball on things. I don't have the budget to hire someone  to partly replace me so I have started looking at ai solutions. 

I looked at Viktor but it doesn't integrate with our booking system Momence where almost all the information we need is stored. I've written down some of the types of automations and notifications I'd like myself and my team to receive on a regular basis so they can act on them - all data would be found in Momence 

Types of automatic prompts 
- 48 hours notice where no one is booked into a class 
- When a class has been below 50% capacity for 3 or more weeks 
- When a class has been above 80% capacity for the last 3 weeks 
-  When a class had not made a profit for the last 3 weeks 
- All business KPIs (I currently pull from individual reports in Momence into a google sheet) 
- Top performing classes and lowest by profit margin and capacity 
- Recommendations for schedule changes - levels, type software classes, time changes based on trends 
- Membership data - churn, retention 
- recommended people to upsell memberships to based on attendance
